title: iTransformer: Treating variates as tokens produces consistent transformer wins on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using iTransformer, a inverted transformer treating variates as tokens. On ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, at horizon 336, Treating variates as tokens produces consistent transformer wins on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1. iTransformer beats both PatchTST and DLinear on 6 multivariate benchmarks. We discuss two limitations: Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity. Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified.
